newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4: Campaign Early Access Confirmed
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/88c8fabaedf1c35cec50fafbf05ba805943df2da.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is Warfare Without Limits. Experience the gripping story of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] first with our Campaign Early Access. Here’s how:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How Do I Access Modern Warfare Campaign Early Access?[/h2][p align="start"][i]Pre-Order, Play Early[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fc1fde9de49a69f09bcbf9fcce54458ed264a7dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] Campaign Early Access is confirmed![/p][p align="start"]Starting on Friday, October 16, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] get Early Access to the game’s Campaign.[/p][p align="start"]This benefit applies to those pre-ordering or pre-purchasing the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h2]No Line Holds Forever[/h2][p align="start"]In the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign, you fight as Private Park, a young South Korean soldier facing live combat for the first time alongside his squad. What begins as a routine mission descends into chaos when North Korea launches a full-scale invasion, forcing Park and his unit into a desperate battle through collapsing cities and counteroffensives.[/p][p align="start"]Beyond the front lines, operator-turned-outlaw Captain Price is operating outside the system he once served. A hunt for revenge draws Price toward a weapon powerful enough to shift the balance of power, setting in motion a conflict far greater than he ever anticipated. Forced into uneasy alliances and off-book operations, Price is pulled deeper into consequences he can no longer escape.[/p][p align="start"]From large-scale battles and covert missions to combined-arms warfare and cinematic set pieces, the campaign delivers grounded combat and gameplay variety across a war that spreads far beyond the front lines.[/p][p align="start"] [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"][u]Click here for more information.[/u][/url][/p][p align="start"][i](*Actual platform availability and start date subject to change.)[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Stay Frosty.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8597bdedbfc8737241f64fe4bbcbcaf7eccb8bae.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Track the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel on the Call of Duty Blog as we move toward additional information drops, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Open Beta, and launch on October 23.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p]Pre-orders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at [url="https://CallofDuty.com"]CallofDuty.com[/url]. For more information on preordering, including Vault Edition content, rewards, and a special Loyalty Discount, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"][u]see the Preorder blog here[/u][/url].[/p][h3] [/h3][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on PC via Steam on Friday, October 23rd, 2026.[/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p align="start"]Infinity Ward, in partnership with Digital Legends, is developing [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] natively for Nintendo Switch 2.[/p][p align="start"]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]* Actual play time subject to possible outages and applicable time zone differences. Actual platform availability and start date subject to change.[/i][/p]

newsitems.title: Former Destiny 2 CM claims Bungie was 'very close to shutting its doors' before the buyout
newsitems.author: Rory Norris
newsitems.contents: It's a bittersweet time for any Destiny fan, as Destiny 2 is now in stasis after its final update. Hell, even This Week In Destiny, my weekly ritual for over a decade now, is coming to an end. All good things must finish, I guess... Read more.

newsitems.title: I'm sad, I'm angry, I'm interested: Destiny's final cutscenes are a painful end to a new saga cut short
newsitems.author: Rory Norris
newsitems.contents: Destiny 2's Monuments of Triumph is here, the final update for the game and potentially the last Destiny anything. Even This Week In Destiny, my weekly ritual for over a decade now, is coming to an end. To that end, Bungie has crammed in as much of a conclusion as possible, given we're actually at the start of a brand-new saga... Read more.

newsitems.title: Time to get a little sadder about Destiny 2: TWIDs are coming to an end
newsitems.author: Andy Chalk
newsitems.contents: Destiny 2 is ending—for all intents and purposes, in fact, it already has, with the launch earlier this week of its final update, Monument of Triumph. More than one Destiny fan at PC Gamer has described the moment as bittersweet—it's not only Destiny 2's last live service update, it's also one of its best—and in a smaller way, this is too: Maybe it's no surprise, but the clockwork-like This Week in Destiny updates will soon be over... Read more.

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ: Explore the Hajin Exclusion Zone
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7a2c6a6d871e593d678a2da9f416c05df5d961a7.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]DMZ // Overview[/h2][p align="start"][i]A High-Stakes, Action-Packed Extraction Shooter[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]DMZ is [i]Call of Duty[/i]’s definitive extraction shooter, a living world with unpredictable enemy encounters, weather, and objectives all brought together by meaningful match-to-match progression and inventory systems. Whether you plan to infil solo or with a squad, this volatile conflict zone offers numerous paths to choose from.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbb2b156cfa462836f7fdda8d2f28f9e511eefe5.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]After experimenting and getting player feedback from the original DMZ Beta, [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]evolves the extraction shooter into a deeper, more cohesive, and more persistent combat experience shaped by what resonated most with players. Set in the Hajin exclusion zone and tied directly to the events of the Campaign, players deploy into a volatile Exclusion Zone, choosing how to survive, whether pushing deeper into dangerous territory for greater rewards, hunting high-value targets, defending against escalating enemy threats, completing story missions, or extracting before the situation becomes untenable.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]DMZ // Setting[/h2][p align="start"][i]Into the Exclusion Zone[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]SUMMARY: Enter a contested exclusion zone as an off-the-books asset tasked with securing advanced military technology before it falls into hostile hands. [/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5ca7111264241a5f195dfac25dfddd1dfd52bba2.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Following the events of the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign, an exclusion zone across the Korean peninsula remains saturated with abandoned military technology, weapons stockpiles, and destabilizing threats. Operating as a shadow CIA asset, you are deployed behind enemy lines and tasked with securing the various weapons and technology left behind before they fall into enemy hands. Both Rogue Operators and enemy combatants are active throughout the zone, forcing every squad to decide when to cooperate, when to engage, and when to disappear before tensions escalate.[/p][p align="start"]Loot, fight, negotiate, betray, and extract whatever you can carry.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Setting // Hajin: The New Frontline[/h3][p align="start"][i]A Region Shaped by Conflict[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Hajin is a dense exclusion zone built around exploration, discovery, and high-risk player-driven operations, where environmental storytelling and hidden discoveries reward players willing to push deeper into the unknown.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/11401a19332b87c5d97b958236390e79aab4789f.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Nestled within a tri-point region bordering Russia and the Korean peninsula, Hajin is a contested exclusion zone where rival forces battle for control of abandoned military technology and strategic assets left behind after the events of the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign.[/p][p align="start"]The atmosphere within the Hajin Exclusion Zone shifts can change based environmental effects, creating new opportunities and challenges on every run. Sudden downpours can reduce visibility and force Operators to adapt how they explore, move and engage, while dense fog banks and overcast skies transform familiar routes into tense navigational gambles.[/p][p align="start"]Scarred by radiation, mass evacuation, and the collapse of civilian infrastructure, the region is one of the largest and most ambitious Call[i] of Duty[/i] environments ever built, designed around exploration, environmental storytelling, and high-risk operations. From the irradiated Fallout reactor and the highly secured Prison complex to the remains of Hajin City and the heavily defended Military Base, every region inside the border area and exclusion zone offers different combat opportunities, sealed or hidden areas waiting to be discovered, traversal challenges and points of interest with hidden entrances accessible only via water, and other operational risks. Players willing to push deeper into the unknown can uncover hidden secrets, pursue high-value gear, and engage in increasingly dangerous missions with greater risks and rewards.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]DMZ // Operations // Story Missions[/h2][p align="start"][i]Operations Pushing the Narrative Forward[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Continue the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] story through narrative-driven Story Missions built for replayability, squad-based action, and evolving storytelling throughout live seasons.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/98fbd9003e450d9b54f78a0d7efec3004cc0aae1.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]A collection of Story Missions expands the narrative of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], and features unique objectives, high-stakes action, and gameplay scenarios unfolding inside specific points of interest across Hajin, all within a live DMZ server populated by other operators pursuing their own missions. Built for squads and solo players with replayability in mind, Story Missions push the broader DMZ narrative forward through new discoveries and fresh challenges over time.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Operations // Dynamic Operations, Side Ops and Free Roam[/h3][p align="start"][i]Activities that Evolve Every Match[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Take on guided Operations featuring evolving scenarios, escalating threats, and climactic moments unique to every match.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eec6fc961d0f785244bbf3563e3632c0a8479112.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Before deployment, your objectives in DMZ are clearly defined: a focus on Story Missions, engaging in Dynamic Operations, and free explorations across Hajin. But no plan is guaranteed to last. The unpredictable nature of DMZ often demands quick adjustments as situations evolve in the field. Whether you decide to stay covert or bring the fight directly to your enemies, every match is an opportunity to push deeper into Hajin, uncover valuable intel and hidden secrets, and hunt down rogue enemy Operators to build your infamy.[/p][p align="start"]Dynamic Operations are multi-step objectives generated for each match and designed to create focused tasks, from neutralizing abandoned weapons programs and securing critical assets to high-risk rescue operations and assaults against hostile forces. Every Operation in this extraction shooter is built around escalating tension, replayability, and large-scale moments capable of impacting activity across the wider region.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/76d2a11d899832f1eae3078145264a0186f7ace1.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Even a seemingly routine task can lead to intriguing exploration: Side Ops are available and include activities like locating trucks across Hajin that have advantageous functionality once they’re repaired, locating lost supply drops, or scaling damaged radio towers. There’s the freedom to explore like never before, even into sectors of extreme danger like the area of heavy fallout in the eastern part of the map, where it takes a gas mask and gumption to find loot only available in this point of interest.[/p][p align="start"]Beyond these Operations, Hajin supports free-roaming exploration for players who want to forge their own path, preserving the open-ended freedom that defines the DMZ experience. Whether hunting rival Operators, scavenging for resources, hunting down dangerous Lieutenants, accessing phones to initiate Dynamic Operations, commandeering a derelict casino while attempting to break into the vault without attracting a rival squad’s attention, or simply surviving long enough to extract, these side tasks add unpredictability and player choice.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]DMZ // A Living World[/h2][p align="start"][i]Low and Slow or Fast and Loud[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Rival factions, roaming patrols, and shifting world events ensure that no two operations unfold the same way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d132c5d789778a8e64513eff003cf3c722eca6c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Players decide how to approach Hajin — moving low and slow through hostile territory, risking everything with an aggressive assault, or something in-between — while dynamic world systems respond to every action. Vehicle convoys move across the roadways, air traffic fills the skies, and hostile forces constantly reposition WMDs and strategic assets. With enemy factions and rival human squads battling for control of key locations, every operation can evolve in unexpected ways. Hajin represents an extreme opportunity for exploration.[/p][p align="start"]DMZ also benefits from the advancements in movement and combat systems introduced in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], including enhanced traversal options like climbing pipes and navigating environmental obstacles with fluidity, alongside refined weapon handling, ballistic authority, and other mechanics that carry across the broader game experience.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]DMZ // A Living World // Emergent Enemies[/h3][p align="start"][i]Advances in Enemy Combat Intelligence[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Improved AI combatants allow for larger combat spaces with coordinated enemy squads, reactive combat behaviors, and more dynamic infantry and vehicle encounters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f4cd320b29df6c1234c37dcfb53e1ac15eec0d5.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]brings a new level combat density beyond anything seen in Call of Duty before. Hostiles throughout the exclusion zone are guarding key areas, traveling in convoys, flying in choppers and moving in large squads.  New squad generation systems help AI adversaries move beyond individual enemy behavior, with units that coordinate, navigate, react, and pressure players more convincingly. Approach lone AI enemies, and expect them to take cover and hold position, freeze, or try to break your line of sight. Combined with advances in game engine physics and squad/vehicle interactions, these systems make combat feel more active and unpredictable, opening the door to new forms of emergent gameplay.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]DMZ // A Living World // Escalating Threats[/h3][p align="start"][i]Push the World, and it Pushes Back[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Escalating threat levels trigger stronger enemy responses, increasingly dangerous reinforcements, and elite forces sent to hunt players down.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/845feceac2caaf5138d7c73b6d5c77705daadd3c.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Hostile threats across Hajin range from ruthless Lieutenants leading specialized units to roaming commander enemies that include tanks, drone swarms, Deathstalker helicopters, Juggernauts, and Elite Strike Teams. The DMZ threat system tracks player activity and escalates enemy responses as operators attract increasing attention inside the region. As threat levels rise, enemy forces mobilize to reassert control, deploying increasingly dangerous reinforcements to hunt players down. These forces include attack helicopters, more dangerous and heavily armored troops and eventually enemy Deathstalkers being dispatched to chase you down.[/p][p align="start"]Survival depends on more than firepower alone; success comes from strategy, adaptability, and controlling the pace of combat before the engagement spirals out of control. One of these ways is using the Stealth Meter, a system that assists Solo players particularly well, as it helps you control combat when facing AI enemies. If you’re close to being spotted by AI adversaries, expect an audio cue and an indicator on your HUD that changes from white to yellow to orange. Hit the deck or get back into cover to prevent the observing hostile from being alerted.  [/p][h3] [/h3][h3]DMZ // Progression // FOB[/h3][p align="start"][i]Forward Operating Base[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: A hub between operations, your FOB can be upgraded to unlock new services, expand operational capabilities, and prepare your squad for future deployments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/20863df32fe99346cc6cc8892005973123ed3cc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Before and after every extraction operation inside the DMZ, players return to their Forward Operating Base (FOB), a central hub built around preparation, progression, and long-term squad support. The FOB gives players access to key operational services including the 3D Printer crafting station, The Stash where inventory items can be stored deployment to deployment, weapon purchasing, a firing range, bounty boards, and additional upgrade systems that unlock over time. It also serves as a staging ground and social hub where squad members can regroup, rearm, inspect their Operators, assist with onboarding newer players, and prepare before deployment. As players earn XP, complete Missions, progress through the Trait System, gaining the reputation and skillset of an elite Tier 1 operator over time, the Forward Operating Base evolves alongside you, unlocking new functionality while visually transforming to better support your growing capabilities.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]A Tour of Your Forward Operating Base[/i][/p][p align="start"]The FOB is the operational backbone of DMZ. Access the following via the physical FOB spaces and streamlined menu navigation. Note that imagery of the FOB will be unveiled at a later date.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Orders and Objectives:[/b] Track your active Missions, review completed objectives, check available completion rewards, and plan future operations before heading back into the field.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stash and Loadout:[/b] Between deployments, players can manage a persistent inventory containing weapons, equipment, consumables, valuables, and special items. Gear can be organized between your Stash, and your Active Duty Operator's Backpack and Loadout. Each Active Duty Operator has their own Backpack and Loadout. The Stash size can also be upgraded by ranking up in DMZ. Operators looking to infil immediately can choose a Free Loadout containing combat essentials.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wallet: [/b]Use in-game cash primarily to purchase weapons and Gunsmithing attachments, as well as rescuing MIA operators, paying for Lieutenant Intel and much more.[/p][/*][*][p]Completing Missions and Ops is the primary source of cash, wired directly to the Wallet in the FOB. Expenditure of funds is a key consideration in DMZ, and players may wish to employ an Active Duty Operator as a cash mule with particular skills when breaking into vaults, defeating HVTs (or other Bounty-tagged human prey) or completing Dynamic Ops to earn cash.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3D Printer:[/b] Gather resources throughout Hajin and return them to the FOB’s crafting station: As a general rule, the 3D Printer is capable of manufacturing a vast array of functional equipment and support gear (with a detailed list later in this blog), excluding Primary, Secondary, and Melee weaponry. Recipes unlock the ability to use component resources to craft a wide variety of Gear; items like night vision goggles, ballistic vests, backpacks, consumables, Killstreaks, and other specialized Equipment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gunsmith: [/b]Weapons and related attachments are purchased using Cash in Gunsmith. The more effective the weapon or attachment the more expensive they are. As you progress through Mission Orders and extract Weapon Manuals from Hajin, the option of purchasing the weapons directly becomes available, but initially you'll have to rely on weapons scavenged during deployments. You can use cash to modify weapons with attachments you've unlocked, including Apex Attachments, but each one has a cost: suppressors, extended mags, powerful optics, and more all cost extra for the added effectiveness.[/p][list][*][p]The Gunsmith allows you to add up to five Attachments to a weapon, along with an Apex Attachment. However, eight-Attachment weapons have been confirmed within Hajin.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Progression tracks across Multiplayer and DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Vendor: [/b]DMZ Operators with enough in-game cash can purchase additional specialized weaponry from the FOB’s military supplier. These weapons are added directly to your Stash. The selection is limited and rotating, refreshing after a period of real-time has occurred. If you’re after a professionally built armament and don’t have the time to extract or purchase a gun and modify it, or use the Gunsmith, then this is an excellent option. Weapon Vendor firearms can be adjusted just like scavenged or purchased weapons, and don’t negatively affect your looting or progression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Firing Range (First Person):[/b] Located adjacent to the Gunsmith and Vendor, the firing range allows Operators to test Primary and Secondary weapon builds in a dedicated first-person training environment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Active Duty (Operators):[/b] Manage your available Operators, including those awaiting recovery after failed exfils. Each Operator maintains their own persistent Backpack, persistent Loadout, and persistent Trait Tree. This mission readiness allows players to prepare specialized kits for different deployment styles. Operator Traits (see below) can also be managed here.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Board:[/b] Review the latest intel on hostile Lieutenants (LTs); high-ranking enemy targets operating throughout Hajin before you drop into a match and attempt to neutralize these targets. Here, you can pay for intel related to a particular Lieutenant that allows you to pinpoint their location more accurately and reach them before your rivals do. Or climb Hunt Towers across Hajin, accessing a terminal to receive intel on the closest Lieutenant to your location. Slay a Lieutenant, and they drop a set of Dog Tags.[/p][list][*][p][b]Lieutenant’s Dog Tags: [/b]Exfilling with these spoils of combat helps populate your Boss Board and are helpful to your continued success as an LT killer. However, they are equally valuable to enemy squads, who can track you via any Lieutenant’s Dog Tags you’ve acquired during a match. Expect fierce resistance from rival teams attempting to appropriate your LT’s Dog Tags, usually at hot exfil points, so they can populate their own Boss Board.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bounty Leaderboard: [/b]Monitor the most dangerous rival players currently operating inside the Exclusion Zone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deploy:[/b] Before deploying into Dynamic Operations or Free Roam your squad can choose how to infil with the Paid Infil System. Go in quiet on foot, or fast and loud in a helicopter or large plane. Do you have the need for a vehicle dropped with you? The game has got you covered.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]DMZ // Progression // Active Duty Operators[/h2][p align="start"][i]Build Your Specialized Squad[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Recruit and customize a roster of specialized Operators while earning progression through every operation inside the DMZ.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bea52286d5ea8d1fd5e2c71d4cf5a9a404011766.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]DMZ features a dedicated progression system built around a persistent inventory and long-term Operator growth. Within the FOB’s “Active Duty” menu, players can create multiple Operators as the Active Duty slot system returns from DMZ Beta, with each Operator owning a backpack and loadout persistent through multiple deployments, and customize them through the Trait System, assembling a roster of professional recruits suited for different mission types and playstyles. The more players accomplish during an operation, the more XP and progression rewards they earn, encouraging more risk-taking and deeper exploration. These multiple layers of progression provide a deep and rewarding experience:[/p][list][*][p][b]Global Player and DMZ XP: [/b]Story Missions, Dynamic Operators, and Side Ops are all excellent methods of obtaining XP, along with additional activities and enemy takedowns.[b] [/b]This is irrespective of whether you successfully exfilled or not; there are no XP penalties for dying during a match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]DMZ XP:[/b] All XP earned in DMZ upgrades your FOB, unlocks new Stations in your FOB, and ranks up your Operator. This allows you to unlock game-changing Traits to customize your playstyle..[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]The Trait Operator Progression System[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Within the Active Duty station of the FOB, players can spend earned Trait Points on individual Operators to improve their effectiveness across a variety of disciplines, utilizing them from a roster of persistent characters. Earn Trait Points during missions and invest them into one of three Trait Trees, each leaning into a different skillset related to combat, scavenging, and other capabilities. Points are tied to the Operator who earned them. Unlock Traits along with passive benefits that allow you the freedom to specialize individual Operators for specific roles, including proficiency in PvP engagements, infiltration, looting, recoveries, or as a cash mule.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Looting[/h3][p align="start"][i]Supplies Where They Should Be[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Search for weapons, equipment, and crafting materials placed naturally throughout the region based on location and strategic value.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/42f0a23fc40e779805097849b97c8ed96c16fafa.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Looting is a core part of progression in DMZ, built around meaningful resource gathering that rewards players who learn the region, study the map, and understand where valuable resources might be found. Finding unique ingredients in Hajin becomes a major focus, especially as you learn recipes – combinations of ingredients allowing the creation of better gear. Hunting for rarer ingredients that build more powerful equipment like printing Killstreaks, improved Plate Carriers, or Backpack types, and searching for recipes that upgrade your 3D printer to enable you to print even more potent items, results in a much more meaningful looting experience.[/p][p align="start"]Supplies and loot are primarily distributed in ways that feel grounded and logical within the world itself, encouraging smart exploration and decision-making. Police stations contain combat gear and tactical equipment. Hospitals may have scarce medical supplies. Residential districts offer valuable crafting resources and scavenged materials. Designed to minimize inventory friction and keep players focused on the action, the looting system emphasizes player agency, preparation, and risk-versus-reward.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Crafting[/h3][p align="start"][i]Build the Gear You Need[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Gather resources throughout Hajin and use the upgraded 3D Printer system to craft equipment, weapons, and high-end gear.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eba9d776f3200d19c586f4fd9f931b0a5bba8db7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Crafting gives players greater control over how they prepare for future operations by transforming recovered resources into valuable equipment and combat-ready tools. Materials are disassembled automatically during a mission so players can stay focused on the action, while inventory management is easy to navigate. Extracted loot can be used back at your FOB within an intuitive crafting system built around a powerful upgradable 3D Printer capable of unlocking increasingly advanced crafting options, allowing players to manufacture equipment and rare gear.[/p][p align="start"]The categories of Gear you can 3D print are as follows:[/p][p align="start"]Here are the categories of Gear:[/p][list][*][p][b]Gear:[/b] Tactical equipment such as NVGs and Parachutes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Backpacks:[/b] Packs of varying sizes and specializations carried into a match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plate Carriers:[/b] Craft different types of armor vests.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tacticals:[/b] Stock up on strategic, non-lethal equipment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lethals:[/b] Assemble offensive equipment designed to damage or eliminate threats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Consumables:[/b] Beneficial items, from pain killers to radiation blockers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Field Upgrades:[/b] Abilities providing tactical support or intelligence. Unlike Multiplayer, Field Upgrades in DMZ do not recharge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire Support Items:[/b] Deployable offensive killstreak support.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tracked Recipes:[/b] A series of tagged recipes you’re on the hunt for.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Items:[/b] A wide variety of items used for a wide variety of purposes.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The deeper players push into the region, the more opportunities they uncover to secure rarer resources needed to support stronger loadouts and specialized playstyles.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Weapon Condition and Variants[/h3][p align="start"][i]Equipment Shaped by Conflict[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Recover damaged weapons and rarer enemy variants shaped by the harsh realities of the exclusion zone.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]After combat, players can scavenge for dropped armaments, many with damaged optics, broken attachments, unstable weapon components, and improvised field repairs that affect both appearance and handling. High-value lieutenants also carry uniquely customized weapons featuring attachments and camouflage finishes.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Recovery Systems[/h3][p align="start"][i]Extract. Or Die Trying[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Failed extractions carry real consequences, but recovery systems ensure players can continue progressing and return to the fight.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1d4e0aeafeb799c3c028b1039746efb22ca1a8ee.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Though squads have multiple options to exfil from Hajin from helicopters to skyhooks, not every deployment ends in success. When an Operator is downed, they may be rescued, left to fend for themselves, or become lost in action. Fortunately, there are additional options:[/p][p align="start"][b]Tourniquet: [/b]A new survival mechanic is the Tourniquet, allowing you to heal to a wounded state if you don’t have self-revive equipped. You won’t last long after a Tourniquet application, so you’ll need to apply additional medical items to reach full health.[/p][p align="start"][b]MIA System: [/b]For those lost in action, the new MIA system allows players to expend in-game cash at the FOB and deploy rescue teams to recover them and continue their progression without starting from scratch. DMZ is designed to preserve the tension and high-stakes risk that define extraction shooter gameplay while remaining a little more forgiving than traditional extraction experiences. Every infil is still a gamble, with valuable rewards, equipment, and resources on the line until you successfully extract. While failed operations carry meaningful setbacks, players continue earning XP, unlocking rewards and traits, and advancing long-term progression. Every deployment moves you forward, but greater success still demands skill and tactical judgment.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]DMZ // PvP[/h2][p align="start"][i]Hunter or Hunter Killer[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Take down rival Operators, build notoriety, and climb the Bounty leaderboard as the hunt escalates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/285149140ea1bac657ce5d14eaf7419252ad5307.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The hostile forces occupying Hajin are dangerous enough, but they’re not the only threat in the Exclusion Zone. Other squads or solo players are also deploying into Hajin, adding an unpredictable human element to every operation as players compete for valuable objectives and extraction opportunities. Every encounter carries uncertainty, forcing squads to decide whether to engage. For players who thrive on competition, DMZ’s Bounty system turns every engagement with rival Operators into a risk-versus-reward decision. Hunting other players raises your notoriety and puts a price on your head, making you more visible and easier to track. As a player’s notoriety grows, successful hunters can become some of the most dangerous targets inside Hajin. Earn a place on the infamous Bounty leaderboard by becoming a notorious killer or a bounty hunter. Secure rival dog tags and successfully extract for substantial payouts, along with serious bragging rights. Every Operator eliminated raises both the rewards and the dangers of operating inside Hajin, though hunting bounty targets can lessen the target on your own back.[/p][p align="start"][b]Proximity Chat: [/b]In these high-tension situations, where life and death hang in the balance, you’ll need to stay frosty and employ vocal communication to end an engagement either peacefully, or with a satisfactory kill. With an upgraded engine comes a revamped Proximity Chat, allowing you to listen to (or mute) rival Operators within the vicinity of you or your squad, along with the following improvements:[/p][list][*][p][b]Distance-Based Vocal Falloff:[/b] Expect to find it easier to hear rival enemies the closer they are to you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Directionality:[/b] Pinpoint chatter more precisely depending on the direction your foe is approaching from.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environmental Voice Reverb:[/b] The type of interior structure or exterior topography affects the reverberations and echo of incoming comms, perhaps giving clues to their whereabouts.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]See You in Hajin[/h3][p align="start"]Built on the same foundation powering [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer — including refined and fluid movement across maps, an expanded equipment and full complement of weaponry, enhanced gunplay and Ballistic Authority — DMZ brings the full breadth of [i]Call of Duty[/i] combat into a persistent extraction experience.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Stay Frosty[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p align="start"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df5080a975ac203fe9a87234bfbcf869d42824d7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Track the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel on the Call of Duty Blog as we move toward additional information drops, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Open Beta, and launch on October 23.[/p][p align="start"]For more information on DMZ, be sure to check out additional announcements at the XBOX Games Showcase, as well as the latest episode of the CODPOD, both on Sunday, June 7. Expect further DMZ intel arriving in the weeks and months ahead.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p]Preorders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at [url="https://CallofDuty.com"]CallofDuty.com[/url]. For more information on preordering, including Vault Edition content, rewards, and a special Loyalty Discount, [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"]see the Preorder blog here[/url][/u].[/p][h3] [/h3][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on PC via Steam on Friday, October 23rd, 2026.[/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p align="start"]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p align="start"] [/p]

newsitems.title: A new Dota 2 update buffs Nature's Prophet and Arc Warden, but everyone's talking about a mysterious Axe 'change'
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
Fresh Dota 2 patch notes have just dropped, and that means the meta will start to creak and shift under the weight of Valve's latest balance adjustments. There are some welcome changes in Dota 2 update 7.41d, along with a few that I'm sure people will question, and even a nice quality-of-life buff. The line that's got people talking, however, is a mysterious footnote for Axe that doesn't appear to have any current meaning. Is it a clue hinting at the next addition to the MOBA? My heart tells me yes.

newsitems.title: 7.41d Gameplay Patch
newsitems.author: flynnch
newsitems.contents:
[p]Patch 7.41d is out now and you can check out the patch notes [url="https://www.dota2.com/patches/7.41d"]here[/url].[/p]

In addition, we've recently addressed the following issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed Greevils not spawning their equipped effects
[*] Fixed Earthshaker's Planetfall Arcana not tracking combos and combo damage properly
[*] Fixed right click on Dota Labs Overlay Map not working when "Auto-Repeat Right Mouse" is enabled
[*] Fixed Bottle with a stored Rune being able to be moved in and out of the backpack
[*] Fixed Harmonizer not considering abilities with charges on cooldown
[*] Fixed Elder Titan's Astral Spirit's movement speed not taking Wind Lace into account
[*] Fixed Elder Titan's Echo Stomp shard not swapping places with Astral Spirit if he is being moved by another ability when the stomp goes off
[*] Fixed Invoker not receiving an Aghanim's Blessing from Alchemist if Alchemist casts Aghanim's Scepter on Invoker when his main inventory is full but the backpack had space
[*] Fixed Alchemist being able to repeatedly give Invoker Aghanim's Blessings if Invoker hasn't chosen his Aghanim's Scepter upgrade
[*] Fixed Invoker not correctly being refunded for his Aghanim's Blessing if Invoker has not selected an Aghanim's Scepter upgrade and Alchemist casts Aghanim's Scepter on him
[*] Fixed Spirit Bear's permanently consumed items not counting towards Lone Druid's net worth
[*] Fixed Spirit Breaker permanently changing teams when he reflects Venomancer's Noxious Plague with Lotus Orb and then casts Planar Pocket on Venomancer before Noxious Plague spreads, then after it spreads to a neutral creep Venomancer uses Helm of the Dominator on that creep
[*] Fixed Venomancer being able to Transmute Spirit Breaker with Hand of Midas through the same process
[*] Fixed Wraith King's Vampiric Spirit not turning Wraith King into a wraith if he levels up at the same time as dying
[*] Ability Draft: Fixed Forge Spirit starting at too high a level
[*] Ability Draft: Fixed Brewmaster's old Aghanim's Scepter being available
[/list]

newsitems.contents:

After more than six months of stealth development, a super duper secret alpha, and a ton of broken sentry guns, TFCL is back and ready for public testing! TFCL is a North American competitive 6v6 league. Registration for TFCL's Alpha Season 2 opened on May 21st and runs through July 5th!
 
To make things even more awesome, they're throwing a $504 prize pool at this season! And medals, of course. Can't forget those!
 
Alpha Season 2 will last approximately 6 weeks, with an additional week or two for playoffs. There will be 12 matches, two per week, on servers located in North America. Entry is free. TFCL will host and configure all match servers, so all you have to do is sit back, compete, and have fun!
 
More information can be found [url=https://tfcleague.com/alpha2]here[/url]!

To make things even more awesome, they're throwing a $504 prize pool at this season! And medals, of course. Can't forget those!


Alpha Season 2 will last approximately 6 weeks, with an additional week or two for playoffs. There will be 12 matches, two per week, on servers located in North America. Entry is free. TFCL will host and configure all match servers, so all you have to do is sit back, compete, and have fun!


More information can be found here!

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2cfac2ca7800e91b1d42af7115e70f83bec622e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Yours for the Taking: Black Ops Season 04 is Here![/u][/h2][p] [/p][h3]The Story So Far[/h3][p] [/p][p]After David Mason is captured by The Guild and Specter Two goes on the offense with their own man on the inside, Karma's Guild-killing virus is finally ready to deploy... but Dorne has one last card to play. A collision of forces at JSOC's secret jungle hideout will determine the shape of the future.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Season 04 Roadmap[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5f2ddd972b454b36a052faf67b8076914fbe6310.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Across [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], Season 04 introduces another massive season of content. Take on Operation Wall Breaker in Endgame, deploy across five new and remastered Multiplayer Maps, hail the return of Fortune’s Keep, fight off the horde in the new Rogue Run game mode set on Ashes of the Damned in Zombies, and much more![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="59AgHBmGozI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Season 04 is yours for the taking. Join the action in this substantial update packed with free and premium content arriving when [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Season 04 goes live on Thursday, June 4th at 9AM PT across all platforms.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Endgame Content[/u][/h2][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]FREE TO PLAY: ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Expanded Operations:[/b] At the start of the season, The Guild strikes back in Operation Wall Breaker, introducing new challenges and rewards alongside the deadly Command Killer Glitch Fracture. In the Mid-Season, keep up the fight in Operation King Killer.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Operator Prestige: [/b]Achieve new milestones in Endgame with the introduction of Operator Prestige. Hit max Combat Rating and Prestige to unlock even more ways to build your playstyle, including an extra Exotic slot, extra Nightmare slot, and a fourth Skill Track![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Skill Track, Two Abilities:[/b] Make mincemeat out of your foes with the addition of the Death Machine Major Ability. In the Mid-Season, get access to the new Guardian Skill Track and send targets over the edge with the Psych Grenade Minor Ability.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Act III: Operation Wall Breaker (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5d75fe1f40689821b2b911b2de669999e716dc1.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][i]The Guild strikes back: a Command Node is preventing Karma’s virus from attacking their network. Scour Avalon for enough Mapping Data to locate the Node and take it down.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]The push to infiltrate The Guild’s network has hit a snag, and unless Karma and her allies can find their way past the company firewall, their plans will have been in vain.[/p][p] [/p][p]In Season 04, players must return to Avalon to find the weak link in Guild security, starting with the search for the region’s hidden network hub. Find it, breach the firewall, and gain the permissions needed to successfully access the command center node.[/p][p] [/p][p]Once you’ve breached the command node, it’s time to crack The Guild’s operations wide open. Enter the ensuing Command Killer Glitch Fracture and complete the mission.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeat the Glitch Boss, Earn Rewards[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1ea98b1519aa15487ab3ba69b1b1bfd5a3cee8f9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Operators who progress through the steps in Act III will earn a bounty of in-game rewards, all while empowering your Operator for the challenges ahead. In the final phase, locate the Command Killer Glitch Fracture to battle through relentless waves of enemies in Nightmare Difficulty.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeat the Command Killer Glitch Boss with 50/50, Razor, or Faulkner to earn their unique “Shatter Shock” Operator Skins.[/p][p] [/p][p]Act III Completion Rewards: [/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 “Shatter Shock” Operator Skin to earn the “Decay” Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn all 3 “Shatter Shock” Operator Skins to access the “Visitors” Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Operation Wall Breaker Rewards[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df0ca290cb02b4fc40ba0a784047b562201959d5.jpg"][/img] [/p][list][*][p]“Brain Freeze” Weapon Charm and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Restore Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Player XP Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Splitter” Emblem and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Token and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Frost Beast” Large Decal and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Fractal Cry” Loading Screen and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Forehead Slap” Emote and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Cold Shoulder” Weapon Blueprint, “Terms of Service” Animated Calling Card, and 7,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]More in the Mid-Season[/p][p] [/p][p]There’s no time to let up while The Guild is fighting this hard to maintain their dominance in Avalon. In the Mid-Season, get ready to take on Act IV: Operation King Killer, introducing new challenges and rewards. Get more intel when the Season 04 Reloaded blog arrives in the lead up to the Mid-Season.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Introducing Operator Prestige (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/54bbdfc86f184154cbde5013871d0b6868e606c9.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Starting with Season 04, Endgame Operators with a maxed-out Combat Rating (CR) will gain the option to enter Operator Prestige 1, starting a whole new leveling journey in exchange for greater power. Entering Prestige discards all equipped Skills, resets the Operator’s CR, discards equipped Field Acquisitions, and resets Loadout weapons to their base rarity.[/p][p] [/p][p]From this fresh state, redeploy to Avalon and start upping your CR again. With each Prestige, your Operator will earn access to additional skillsets, including:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Prestige 1: [/b]Extra Exotic Skill Slot[/p][p][b]Prestige 2: [/b]Extra Nightmare Skill Slot[/p][p][b]Prestige 3: [/b]Equip a 4th Skill Track[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3]Guardian Skill Track, Two New Abilities[/h3][p] [/p][p]At launch, unleash fury on your enemies as the devastating Death Machine joins the list of available Major Abilities. In the Mid-Season, keep your armor and ammo stocked with the new Guardian Skill Track and send foes into a psychotic spiral with the addition of the Psych Grenade Minor Ability.[/p][p] [/p][p]Skill Track: Guardian (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Stand your ground and turn pressure into power. The Guardian skill track makes you a frontline anchor, shrugging off damage, punishing attackers, and sustaining both yourself and your squad. With stronger defenses, better resource drops, and proximity-based revives, Guardians do not just survive the fight, they control it.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Payback: [/b]Enemies that damage the player receive damage themselves.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Battle Cache: [/b]Increased chance to spawn an Ammo/Armor Resupply pack when eliminating an enemy.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Power Tap: [/b]Picking up Ammo/Armor Resupply packs also grants Equipment recharge.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Fortified: [/b]Reduce incoming damage for every currently equipped plate. The more plates equipped, the bigger the damage reduction.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Iron Grip: [/b]Reduce hip fire bullet spread and reduce flinch when getting hit.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Rescue Pulse: [/b]If allies are downed, the player can revive them just by being near them. If the player goes down, other players can revive them just by being nearby.[/p][p] [/p][p]New Major Ability: Death Machine (Launch)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c4e3524cc1797ee944ea5dac20ecfb501217e187.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Deadly machine gun. High damage per shot and large magazine capacity.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]New Minor Ability: Psych Grenade (Mid-Season)[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Explodes on impact, releasing a lingering cloud of hallucinogenic gas that brain-rots enemies.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Endgame's free-to-play period will extend to the end of Season 05, so bring your friends and jump into all the new content waiting for you in Avalon! If you haven't tried Endgame yet, now's the perfect time to start earning all the Weapon Camos, Operator Skins, and additional rewards the mode has to offer.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Multiplayer Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] At launch, descend into a Guild procedure where the patient’s unstable mind reshapes the map in Liminal, battle within a Japanese game show in Primetime, and watch your step on the remastered Vertigo. In the Mid-Season, play through a map of traps in the new Zenith and activate a rocket on the remastered Launch.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Modes:[/b] Wind back the clock with Black Ops Classic, wield sleek weapons in Blueprint Gun Game, and adapt to your given Loadout in 6v6 Gunfight. Later in the season, cycle through weapons in Team Blueprint Sharpshooter and ditch the ranged weapons in Knife Fight.   [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Additional Loadout Content:[/b] Drop deadly munitions over their heads with the new Iron Rain Scorestreak, a high-altitude, player-controlled aircraft providing a bird’s-eye view of the battle. Upgrade it further with the Active Camo or Tactical Radar Overclocks.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Black Ops 7 Ranked Play:[/b] Get wins and climb the Ranks in the next season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, featuring a completely overhauled transparent Skill Rating system where every point of SR earned and lost is clearly explained in the post-match summary.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][b] [/b] [/p][p]Liminal (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e41adb763502e9e78dfb7299debb93b6ff9c5dda.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Descend into a live Guild procedure mid-test, where the patient’s response to the experiment actively rewrites the center of the map. When the subject is calm, a red pillar stands intact on a raised platform; when agitation spikes, it fractures and slams into a crater, throwing up fresh cover and new angles around the impact zone.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/71d96c17491b305bf01c5c187bc695a53582f65f.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]When the subject accepts the procedure, the space shifts into a “nature” state, with organic growth reclaiming the central structure and subtly reshaping lanes and sightlines. Corridors feed the core from both sides, cutting past elevators on one flank and offices on the other, keeping rotations tight and fights constant as the room changes under pressure.[/p][p] [/p][p]Primetime (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0c9098082f493b559e2c1d8b78e40145a527b15a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Let no obstacle stand in your way on Primetime, a new 6v6 Multiplayer map themed around a Japanese game show obstacle course. Battle over speed tracks, Wall Jump across bound pads, and rack up points on the board as Operators weave between supersized crates.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1c2e31f1d5eb5e7db7f00cf9b9b7e1ab8328ba4f.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Make a splash across the Pool track running over the water, a catapult on either end providing quick access to the middle. To get out of the limelight, head to the close-quarters Backstage or head further out along the southern Cargo path running parallel to the course.[/p][p] [/p][p]Vertigo (Launch)[/p][p][i]Remaster, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e206044cb10042875fd611613237fffdf87bb8f8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]First introduced in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 2[/i], Vertigo returns fully remastered and ready for action in [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. The map features a new Japanese setting, though the layout will be familiar to veterans of the original.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/745fab79d4f7c4a0bed609fef82180f7b9090ef8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Watch your balance as the wind whips by atop the massive skyscraper, newly refurbished as Guild property. A steep drop-off awaits careless Operators fighting along the outer perimeter amongst the Vents, Utility and Storage sheds, and alongside the Helipad. For sturdier ground, head to the inner walkway connected to the East and West Wing, which funnel players into a tight space with guardrails to keep you from plummeting to your demise. [/p][p] [/p][p]Zenith (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1ea3a92bed9280ae53acbe127d72cf1424f7f18a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Breach a luxurious cliffside abode in Zenith, a waterfall in the distance and pristine lighting guiding you through the immaculate grounds. Battle inside the building, marveling at the bleeding edge tech and expensive artwork, and check for details on the site intrusion in the Security room.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4e782674c98bc0fab312df57614bedb98cac55e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For a sneakier approach, traverse the running water below, accessible from the outside and from a secret entrance via the inner Office. Take a good look at the bookshelf to discover the trigger mechanism.[/p][p] [/p][p]Launch (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Remastered, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/341dab6346fd74b04271dcb83664a3371fe9233b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Launch map first introduced in the original [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops[/i] returns![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/93d26d51350d79805bd076f68260c59af527539f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Deploy to this mid-sized map and fight the enemy team across the industrial facility, including the Fuel Yard, Loading, and the Launch Pad itself. Climb the stairwells to battle around the blast shield or fight below the rocket’s thrusters… just not when it’s taking off.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p] [/p][p]Black Ops Classic (Launch)[/p][p][i]New Mode (Moshpit)[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Wind back the clock in Black Ops Classic, a new throwback mode inspired by classic [i]Black Ops[/i] gameplay. With simplified movement and streamlined Loadouts, this mode focuses on tactical positioning and classic multiplayer fundamentals built on the modern foundation of [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. Jump into iconic throwback maps and core modes including Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint and Kill Confirmed.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Restrictions: [/b]No Overclock Abilities. No Perk Combat Specialty bonus.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Limited Selection: [/b]Scorestreaks, Perks, Lethal, Tactical, Wildcards, Melee Weapon, Field Upgrades.[/p][p] [/p][p]Blueprint Gun Game (Launch)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Every plan needs a good outline. Blueprint Gun Game returns for its [i]Black Ops 7 [/i]debut, challenging players to advance through a lineup of Weapon Blueprints. There are no Scorestreaks or Loadouts involved here, just plain old gun skill. Eliminate players with your weapons to advance to the next weapon.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d9c0c732e7c098341c8e9321e1d3097728d11f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The first player to earn an elimination with every weapon wins. Eliminate enemies with a melee attack to set them back one weapon in the rotation, and use the intel provided by the persistent UAV to track down your next target.[/p][p] [/p][p]6v6 Gunfight (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Get ready to up the ante as Gunfight returns with a 6v6 spin. Players begin each round with the same pre-determined Loadout that changes every two rounds. Health regeneration and respawns are disabled, so make your shots count. If neither team is wiped out in the specified time, the Overtime Flag will spawn; capture it to secure the round win.[/p][p] [/p][p]Team Blueprint Sharpshooter (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Grab your squad and drop into Team Blueprint Sharpshooter, the 6v6 Multiplayer mode where Weapon Blueprints rotate every few seconds. Each weapon cycle swaps to the same new weapon for every Operator, testing your ability to adapt fast, fight hard, and push for victory.[/p][p] [/p][p]Knife Fight (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]This time it’s personal. Ditch the ranged weapons in this melee-only take on the fan-favorite Gunfight mode that forces Operators into intense, close-quarters fights.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Additional Loadout Content[/h3][p] [/p][p]Make your move from above. Call in the new Iron Rain Scorestreak to rise high above the field of battle, raining deadly munitions on the enemy team.[/p][p] [/p][p]New Scorestreak[/p][p][b]Scorestreak: Iron Rain (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][b]Score: [/b]825[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/998da5f5a970e7355a5375f125af3aa53174fa2a.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][i]A high-altitude, player-controlled aircraft that provides a bird’s-eye view of the battlefield, allowing tracking and eliminating enemies from above.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Enjoy a birds-eye view of the action below while using this new medium cost Scorestreak designed to pummel enemy forces from above. When called in by the enemy, reach for your Launcher or run for cover.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Overclock Abilities[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Active Camo: [/b]Keeps aircraft hidden. Attacking or taking damage temporarily breaks camouflage.[/p][p][b]Tactical Radar: [/b]Reveals and pings nearby enemies to allies. Grants bonus score when marked enemies are eliminated.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Season 04 Multiplayer Ranked Play[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bdd019930b729c42a1fe67d1e665ac766fa8dcca.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Season 04 Ranked Play Overview[/p][p] [/p][p]Multiplayer Ranked Play gives players the ultimate competitive [i]Call of Duty [/i]experience by offering the same settings, maps, modes, and weapon restrictions used by the Call of Duty® League™.[/p][p] [/p][p]Earn career rewards throughout the lifespan of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Ranked Play, including Rank Skins and Win Challenge rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]Ranking System Update[/p][p][/p][p][i]Black Ops 7[/i] Ranked Play is getting clearer in Season 04. The SR (Skill Rating) System has been completely overhauled to remove hidden MMR and instead provide full transparency over every single point of earned or lost SR. In Season 04, your SR gains and losses are driven entirely by your visible Rank and your performance relative to the Rank and performance of other players in the match. Outperform players in your Rank or above you and you’ll continue to climb, but struggle to beat players at your Rank or below you and big SR gains will be harder to come by.[/p][p] [/p][p]SR gains and losses are broken down in detail in the updated Ranked Play Post-Match Summary after each match, so you know exactly what moved the needle. Here are the major changes coming with this SR System overhaul in Season 04:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]SR Gains after Wins[/b][/p][p]The following can be awarded after a Ranked Play win:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b]Base Win: [/b]Earn a flat +20 SR for every win, regardless of your current Rank.  [b]Scoreboard Bonus: [/b]Finish among the top 4 players of the match to earn an SR bonus. The higher your Scoreboard position, the bigger the bonus.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Opponent Rank Adjustment: [/b]Receive an SR Adjustment based on the relative Rank of Opponents beaten compared with your current Rank:[/p][list][*][p]Outperform opponents that are higher Rank than you and you’ll receive additional SR bonuses for beating better players.[/p][/*][*][p]However, get beaten by lower Ranked opponents and your SR total for the match will be reduced because you were outperformed by weaker opponents.[/p][/*][*][p]Additionally, outperforming lower Ranked opponents will reduce your SR total for the match because you were expected to perform better than the weaker opponents you beat.[/p][/*][*][p]To maximize your Opponent Rank adjustment and receive big SR gains: prove you belong to a higher Rank by outperforming opponents that are currently in your Rank or are higher Rank than you.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Underdog Team Bonus: [/b]Awarded if you beat a significantly higher-Ranked team, while a [b]Favored Team Penalty[/b] is subtracted if the team you beat was lower Ranked.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]SR Deductions after Losses:[/b][/p][p]The following SR deductions and adjustments occur after a Ranked Play loss:[/p][p][b]Base Loss: [/b]-20 SR is deducted when losing a match in Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, or Diamond Ranks. This Base Loss amount increases for Crimson Rank and above so that players are required to consistently exceed expectations of their current Rank to continue to climb into the highest Ranks and the Top 250:[/p][list][*][p][b]Crimson Rank:[/b] -30 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]10,000 SR+:[/b] -40 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]12,500 SR+: [/b]-50 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]15,000 SR+: -[/b]55 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]17,500 SR+:[/b] -60 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]20,000 SR+:[/b] -65 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Underdog Team Bonus: [/b]Your SR loss for the match is reduced if you lost to a significantly higher-Ranked team. Lose to a lower Ranked team and you’ll receive a bigger SR loss via the [b]Favored Team Penalty[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]Party Size Restriction Update[/p][p] [/p][p]Back in Season 02, [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Ranked Play introduced Party Size Restrictions that limited players in Crimson and above to two-player parties. This was done to ensure that parties did not give players in the highest Ranks a competitive advantage. However, we’ve seen consistent feedback from players who feel like the current party rules are too restrictive and have impacted their ability to party up with friends in Ranked.[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 04 changes the Ranked Play Party Size Restrictions. Crimson players will now be free to form up to four-player parties without size restrictions. Iridescent and Top 250 players will continue to be restricted to two-player parties to ensure that parties do not give players competing for the top Rank a competitive advantage.[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 04 Ranked Play Rewards[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/be359af1040745b3f9ccd485a50cfc69b5d03ac2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b]Each season comes with its own seasonal rewards that that can only be earned throughout the duration of that season, including the following Weapon Blueprint, Large Decal, Calling Cards, and Weapon Camos:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b]Get 10 Wins:[/b] Pro Issue Far from their idyllic presentation in other forms of Nuketown, this neighborhood is tainted with corruption, and the denizens and their Rad-Hounds are anything but friendly.[/p][p][/p][p]Scour the map for upgrades: Perks, Pack-a-Punch, Mystery Box, the Arsenal, Wall Buys, and anything else you can get your hands on to climb the rounds in a confined location, extending from the cul-de-sac out to Trinity Ave. You might not get out alive, but you can at least take down as many undead as you can with you.[/p][p] [/p][p]Survive as long as you can to earn the following rewards:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]“Population: Just You” Animated Emblem and 1,000 XP (complete Round 10).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dead End” Weapon Charm and 2,500 XP (complete Round 25)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Time Out” GobbleGum and 5,000 XP (complete Round 50)[/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3]Directed Mode: Totenreich (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/223890cb38e435f8d90158dee6bcfb7e6a7684e9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get extra guidance for the Main Quest on Totenreich as Season 04 brings Directed Mode to the map, delivering on-screen quest steps and a max round cap of 15.[/p][p] [/p][p]Explore the ancient fishing village’s dark past under the shadow of giants while battling new enemies including the undead Viking warrior spirit known as the Necropincer, a trident wielding adversary with a giant crab claw in place of its left arm. Stay tuned for the Season 04 Reloaded blog arriving just prior to the Mid-Season for more.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty®: Warzone™ Content[/u][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ded8d295d0f30beb111c545cc63b53b0b76a6f67.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Fortune’s Keep Refresh:[/b] The Resurgence map pool expands in Season 04 as the Fortune’s Keep Refresh arrives. Whether you’re returning to the location or visiting for the first time, this iteration supports the advanced movement mechanics and other features of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] along with a handful of updated micro POIs and other changes.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Modes:[/b] Fight for your slice of Verdansk in the 52v52 Clash mode arriving at launch. In the Mid-Season, be the first squad to cycle through every weapon in Squad Gun Game.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]A New Season in Rebirth Island: [/b]The snow has melted and a new season arrives in Rebirth Island. Hang up your snow gear, enjoy the fresh breeze, and push toward that next victory.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Gameplay Features:[/b] Gain access to a mobile Black Market with the new Shadowlink Contract exclusively available in Fortune’s Keep Refresh. Get safely back on your feet into cover with the Advanced Self Revive, and later in the season, see if you have what it takes to acquire and complete the difficult Champion’s Quest.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Resurgence Ranked Play: [/b]Rank up and earn rewards in a new season of Ranked Play: Resurgence including unique Weapon Camos you won’t want to miss.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b] [/b][/p][p] [/p][h3]Fortune’s Keep Refresh (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/40332ccc27a7a620a39812f8b07aea4f9a3022dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It’s the Fortune’s Keep you know and love, now playable like never before. Revisit your favorite haunts and explore new points of interests with enhanced movement and fresh features that bring a new depth to gameplay. For new and returning players, here’s a review of the major points of interest on the map, followed by a closer look at three updated micro POIs found throughout the island.[/p][p] [/p][h3]The Major POIs[/h3][p] [/p][p]Terraces[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/532f414b9d26c98981aa0718f3ba68e643b51d9f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Surrounded by high walls and buildings, the Terraces are a well-fortified POI with access points out to the northern shore and toward the adjacent Keep. Stay on the move and avoid the central fountain, a focal point for all the surrounding vantage points around it. Use the stairs and vine trellises located all over the area to gain some elevation.[/p][p] [/p][p]Keep[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/15edbe05b7eecd878ff0c3171f855476f6b09c85.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Prepare for a variety of engagement types across the Keep; although the structure is large, its sheer number of corridors and rooms turn a long-distance fight into a short one in seconds. The POI extends to the Keep’s outer walls, so check every corner while approaching the sprawling compound, and use all available intel to track enemy movement within.[/p][p] [/p][p]Gatehouse[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f209d5c8770564a095ec02b6b388513155a9f9e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Gatehouse is the entrance to the Keep’s primary grounds and sits directly in the center of the island. Surrounded by several other major POIs, it’s a difficult area to control, though the reward is worth the risk if you’re ready for constant engagements around it. Note the nearby sewer entrance for a concealed flanking path, and the Ascender giving access to the top of the Gatehouse battlements.[/p][p] [/p][p]Bay[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/06ed951dcec95910cb62bdc5a76c71dcfea2a198.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Positioned along the eastern shore, the once peaceful Bay is home to beachfronts, cliffsides, and the new Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory. Use the Bay’s lowered elevation to keep out sight from the main roads, and as a reliable access point for watercraft with helipad right next to the boat launch. Don’t miss the cliff tunnels up the dirt path, providing a stealthy approach toward the Keep.[/p][p] [/p][p]Winery[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6b086196f1126fbb482d81ca551ea8c1f9db0bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Taking up a significant portion of the island’s east end, the Winery is often contested, whether fighting within the center courtyard or sending out suppressive fire around its perimeter. Note that there are several points of access down into the basement below, a haven from the action above, though be prepared for close-quarters combat should an enemy follow you there.[/p][p] [/p][p]Pier[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d42973c10909b75c24ac4a11d031fbc346e28db.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Like the Bay POI, the Pier offers a respite from the main action of the island, but that hardly makes it a light walk along the beach. Expect to encounter vehicles traversing the Pier as it is also near a major crossroad. Use the dotted beach terrain and scenery, as well as the cliffside, to escape from tough fights and get into a better position for the counterattack.[/p][p] [/p][p]Lighthouse[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ba302c5def3483f85527864847384ffe544dab4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check for snipers when approaching the Lighthouse, an Ascender giving access to its upper platform with views over a significant portion of the surrounding area. The shoreline here is extremely dangerous, with little cover against attacks from above. Instead, consider exploring behind the Lighthouse when traversing the nearby grounds, full of cover points with a tunnel into the cliffside and zipline toward Smuggler’s Cove.[/p][p] [/p][p]Overlook[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bb8248af12e1f8600098e0812c6980bf00a5284a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Overlook provides a powerful vantage point over the Town and its surrounding areas. The section closest to Smuggler’s Cove features a high-end restaurant with a picturesque view of both the ocean and the eastern end of Fortune’s Keep, while farther up you’ll find a small village area including access to the tallest section of the cliff. Claiming this area offers great map control in the vicinity, so long as the gas hasn’t cleared the place out yet.[/p][p] [/p][p]Town[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d7dfecc39f899bb1918d2db014126951a461b557.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Operators seeking close-quarters, urban combat should head into Town along the map’s western shore. A treasure trove a loot awaits within its tightly packed layout, so long as you’re prepared to engage enemies at a moment’s notice and often face to face. Its lower elevation makes the area susceptible to attacks from the outside, so be on the lookout for enemy forces when it’s time to exit the area.[/p][p] [/p][p]Graveyard[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4334c93ee1f02c780b11667ef4a1510b981c1562.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There’s little cover here, but the tombs and outer walls do provide some cover in a pinch. There’s a steep drop off to the shore here, so beware of enemy squads attempting a flanking attack from the west. Within the Graveyard, look for the easternmost sepulcher providing access to a belowground passageway. If you prefer a clear view, climb the stairs to the top of the nearby round tower.[/p][p] [/p][p]Grotto[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/92e38e32438a9d449c29ba73c5561b02349b20cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get way below the action in the Grotto, positioned at the base of the cliffs with access to several cave systems leading to other parts of the map like the Lighthouse and the Graveyard. Getting to these cave systems requires landing safely and fighting any enemy squads within the Grotto or directly above on the surface.[/p][p] [/p][p]Smuggler’s Cove[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db890d8a6b3c1a6fb46c27fc432c2bbb402fcd28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Secluded from the main island, Smuggler’s Cove upholds its reputation for stockpiling illegally sourced cargo within the deep-sea caves. The shallow waters somewhat limit mobility, so seek out an elevated position when possible. For a quick escape, back up into the cave systems of the nearby Grotto or use the area’s system of ladders, walkways, and Ascenders to reclaim the high ground.[/p][p] [/p][p]Research Vessel[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d38397073857dfac0db935621ac8621dba4bff4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This pontoon-style watercraft circles the shoreline of Fortune’s Keep in the opening minutes of the match before eventually dropping anchor. The multi-level POI is equipped with a Buy Station, Ammo Cache, UAV Tower, and a limited use POI wide gas decontamination system. It’s the only POI on Fortune’s Keep that maintains a UAV Tower which makes it an incredibly desirable location for tracking enemy movement. When inland, watch for snipers firing from the deck.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Micro POI Updates[/h3][p] [/p][p]Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b9751ae3ad4654c5fc4f9e8bb0557f716c9a6171.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Head to the Bay POI to visit Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory located right on the boat launch. The two-story building features the latest in marine research, though in the midst of battle, keep your eyes peeled for enemies making their way into the main structure. With a staircase on either side and an assortment of tightly packed rooms, combat can erupt at any moment.[/p][p][/p][p]For a simpler cover point, move into one of the smaller research center outbuildings, one positioned on the water by the boat launch ramp and the other above the main building for a more elevated vantage point. [/p][p] [/p][p]Capt. Bubby’s Chum Haus[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c66e8e7df5d69f77d57077bdd68c073e44e11a75.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Between the Pier and Lighthouse now stands the fast-food restaurant, Capt. Bubby’s Chum Haus. Stop in for some grub straight from the shoreline, from Bubby’s Up-Chunk Chowder to Smothered Seagull Cutlet. The one-story building marks a strong cover point in the area. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/887b4b0f6c08ba5f52fff33e6e61842018a5c834.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fire out the windows on enemy targets in the surrounding lot or get behind the service counter for defending against enemies attempting to breach the building.[/p][p] [/p][p]Smuggler HQ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e1b4eda4c41b00a821e066a9cc87562ea077157a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Positioned right near the opening of the Grotto near the Gatehouse, the Smuggler HQ offers a valuable looting and cover point positioned right in the center of the map. Use the cluster of buildings and shipping containers to get out of sight from the main roads, resupply, and ambush unsuspecting passersby. The centrally located POI offers a great pivot point toward other areas of the map, whether your squad’s planning an attack toward the northern Keep or elsewhere on the island.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]New Modes and Weekend LTMS (Launch, Mid-Season)[/h3][p] [/p][p]Clash (Launch)[/p][p][i]52v52, Verdansk, Returning[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/61c2144149030a721793d41d07da1739baa04757.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Prepare for a largescale team skirmish in the 52v52 Clash Mode, with the battle location taking place in one of nine POIs within Verdansk, including the returning POIs Farm, Promenade East, Quarry, and Boneyard plus five new Clash zones in Airport, Signal Station, Launch Pad, Port, and Factory.[/p][p] [/p][p]The first team to reach the point limit — or whoever has the highest point total when the match timer runs out — wins the game, with points being allocated as such:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 point per elimination.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 10 points per completed Contract.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 20 points per each bonus crate capture.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 40 points per each Domination point capture.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Get the advantage any way you can, from seeking out vehicles including the new LTV mid-sized truck equipped with a turret, completing Contracts for points and in-match rewards, and building up your cash reserves for Buy Station purchases like the Death Machine, D.A.W.G., and, when it’s time to bring in the big guns, the VTOL Warship. Work with your squad and the greater team to push the fight, capture Domination points, and grind the enemy forces into the dirt.[/p][p] [/p][p]Squad Gun Game (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Resurgence Maps[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Experience Gun Game in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] for the first time ever as squads drop into Resurgence maps with the objective of being the first to cycle through a pre-determined number of weapons.
